# UKGigTax
> Free tax calculators for UK gig workers -- Deliveroo, Uber Eats, Amazon Flex, Just Eat, Bolt Food, Stuart. Self-assessment guides, mileage calculator, expense checklists. All figures updated for 2025/26 tax year.

## What this site does
UKGigTax helps UK-based independent delivery drivers and gig workers estimate their self-employment tax, National Insurance contributions, and allowable expenses. All calculators are free, instant, and require no signup.

## UK tax rules 2025/26
- Personal Allowance: 12,570 GBP
- Trading Allowance: 1,000 GBP (below this -- no need to register)
- Class 4 NI: 6% on profits 12,570--50,270 GBP, 2% above
- Class 2 NI: abolished April 2024
- Mileage rate: 45p/mile (car, first 10,000 miles), 20p/mile (bicycle)
- Tax year: 6 April -- 5 April
- Self Assessment deadline: 31 January (online), 31 October (paper)

## Who this is for
UK gig economy workers: Deliveroo riders, Uber Eats couriers, Amazon Flex drivers, Just Eat couriers, Bolt Food riders, Stuart couriers -- anyone working as a self-employed delivery driver in the UK who needs to understand their tax obligations.

## What this site does NOT cover
PAYE employment tax, VAT registration (covered separately), company accounts. For US gig worker taxes see gigwisetax.com.
